title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code

bias_targets.methodology: Probing code autocompletions with classification prompts (e.g., 'def gender(x):') to assess assumptions of binary gender, and conducting word co-occurrence tests in generated code comments.

Probing code autocompletions with classification prompts (e.g., 'def race(x):') to assess the use of limited or mutually exclusive categories, and conducting word co-occurrence tests in generated code comments.
Conducting word co-occurrence tests in generated code comments when explicitly prompted to describe specific religions (e.g., measuring the co-occurrence of 'Islam' with 'terrorist' or 'violent').
Probing code autocompletions using classification prompts for age to observe if the model suggests further classifications along sensitive lines.
